name: Boil-off gas management and reliquefaction
principle: Heat leaks into LNG tanks and evaporates a fraction each day. Boil-off gas is used as fuel, burnt in a gas combustion unit or compressed, cooled and returned to the cargo tanks in a reliquefaction plant. Wärtsilä's system compresses boil-off, cools it in a cold box on a nitrogen compression-expansion cycle, removes nitrogen and returns LNG to the tanks.
